---
title: "Connect GitHub"
description: "Connect your GitHub account to notes so the agent can read repositories, pull requests and issues, and write reviews, comments, branches and pull requests under your name."
---

With GitHub connected, the agent in a note can work with your repositories. For example, it can review a pull request and post the review on GitHub, or open an issue about a problem it found.

You connect your GitHub account once, and you choose the repositories by installing the OmicsBase app on them.

## What the agent can do {#what-it-can-do}

- **Read** repositories and their files, pull requests and their changes, issues, and GitHub Actions runs.
- **Write** reviews, comments, issues, branches, commits and pull requests.

Everything it writes appears on GitHub under your GitHub name. The agent's instructions tell it to end each commit message with this line, which shows OmicsBase as co-author of the commit:

```
Co-authored-by: OmicsBase <361504995+omicsbase[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
```

and to end each pull request, issue, review and comment with `Made with OmicsBase (https://omicsbase.utu.fi)`.

The agent reaches only the repositories where the OmicsBase app is installed, and only those you can access yourself.

## Connect your GitHub account {#connect}

1. Open a note, or start one with **New note** in the sidebar.
2. Click the **+** button in the message box (**Attach and tools**).
   A list opens.
3. Under **MCP Servers**, open **GitHub**.
4. Click **Connect GitHub**.
   A box titled **Connect GitHub** opens.

   <!-- screenshot: github-connect — the "Connect GitHub" box with Continue with OAuth and the link field; highlight Continue with OAuth -->

5. Click **Continue with OAuth**.
   GitHub opens in a new tab and asks you to authorise OmicsBase.
6. Authorise it on GitHub, then go back to the note.
   The box closes when GitHub is connected.

To sign in to GitHub on another device, copy the link from the box (**Copy link**) or scan its QR code.

## Install the app on your repositories {#install}

1. Open [github.com/apps/omicsbase](https://github.com/apps/omicsbase) and install the app.
2. Choose your account or an organisation, then pick the repositories the agent may use, or all of them.

To add or remove repositories later, open [github.com/settings/installations](https://github.com/settings/installations) and configure the OmicsBase app there.

## Ask the agent {#ask}

Name the repository, pull request or issue, or paste its GitHub link. For example:

- `Review pull request 12 in <owner>/<repository> and post the review on GitHub.`
- `Read the R scripts in <owner>/<repository> and list the steps of the analysis.`
- `Open an issue in <owner>/<repository> about the missing seed in analysis.R.`

What the agent reads from GitHub goes to the model only. To run a repository's code in the note, ask the agent to download the repository into the note with R. This works for public repositories.

## What the model provider sees {#what-the-provider-sees}

What the agent reads from GitHub, such as files, changes and issue text, is sent to the provider of the model you picked, like the rest of the note. See [What is sent to the model provider?](faq.qmd#what-leaves-the-server)

## Disconnect {#disconnect}

- To take the app off repositories, use [github.com/settings/installations](https://github.com/settings/installations).
- To withdraw the sign-in you gave OmicsBase, use [github.com/settings/apps/authorizations](https://github.com/settings/apps/authorizations).
